virtual-wan-hub-fixed-cost.title: Each hub has a fixed monthly cost
virtual-wan-hub-fixed-cost.body: This estimate has more than one virtual hub. Microsoft says each hub incurs fixed monthly costs regardless of traffic, so add a hub only in a region where connectivity needs justify it.

citation.source: Well-Architected Framework service guide for Azure Virtual WAN
citation.quote: Each hub incurs fixed monthly costs regardless of traffic volume. Add hubs only where connectivity requirements justify the cost.

virtual-wan-size-routing-units.title: Size extra routing units to the real workload
virtual-wan-size-routing-units.body: This estimate adds routing infrastructure units beyond the 2 included. Microsoft advises sizing them to actual workload needs, not the maximum theoretical capacity, so confirm the VM count per hub.

citation.source: Well-Architected Framework service guide for Azure Virtual WAN
citation.quote: Size routing infrastructure units based on actual workload needs rather than maximum theoretical capacity.

virtual-wan-size-scale-units.title: Size gateway scale units to the real throughput
virtual-wan-size-scale-units.body: This estimate buys gateway scale units. Microsoft advises sizing them to actual throughput requirements; each unit is billed every hour it exists.

citation.source: Well-Architected Framework service guide for Azure Virtual WAN
citation.quote: Size gateway scale units based on actual throughput requirements.
